_classes.name: NYS 'each agency' resolved to All agencies / 'Every city agency' (Council label) or State agencies for industrial development agencies
_classes.rule: agency_full == 'Every city agency' OR ('industrial development' in actor_resolved_model.lower() AND agency in ('State agencies','All agencies'))

_classes.name: actor_raw 'the state' resolved to a specific agency instead of State agencies / State of New York
_classes.rule: re.fullmatch(r'(the )?state', actor_raw.lower().strip()) AND agency != 'State agencies' (some hits may be context-justified, e.g. 2013-S6887-80 DVS)

_classes.name: 'the employer' in State employee-contract laws resolved to Public employers instead of the State
_classes.rule: actor_raw.lower().strip()=='the employer' AND agency=='Public employers' AND 'state' in actor_resolved_model.lower()

_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real operative duties (list items under a 'shall:' lead-in, 'will' clauses)
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='designation_no_actor' AND (quote matches r'^[A-Z][a-z]+ (whether|a|an|the|and)\b' OR r'\b(will|shall|must)\b'); noisy, e.g. 2009-A10260-01 is a purpose clause; 385 designation_no_actor drops total

_classes.name: effective-date parser: 'first day of the first month next succeeding the Nth day' left unparsed
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].rule=='unparsed' AND raw_clause matches r'first day of the (first )?(calendar )?month next succeeding' (laws; 57 records on them lack effective/deadline dates)

_classes.name: 'shall have and is hereby vested with ... jurisdiction' stored as duty
_classes.rule: file==duties AND quote matches r'is hereby vested with|shall have (the )?(sole )?(jurisdiction|power|authority)\b' AND no other 'shall <verb>' or 'duty' in quote

_classes.name: dated recurring deadline stored as none (known class, recurrence count)
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='none' AND quote matches r'beginning (in|on) <Month>|(on or before|by) <Month> \w+ of each year'

_classes.name: government power to grant exemptions dropped as exemption_or_applicability
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='exemption_or_applicability' AND quote matches r'\b(commission|commissioner|department|board|secretary|director)\b[^.]{0,40}\bmay\b[^.]{0,20}\bexempt' (2011-A55-27 is an interstate commission, not NY)

_classes.name: deadline_split drop with no surviving record
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='deadline_split'; whether a sibling record survived needs per-law check
